title: How to Make Comparison Your Teacher
coreMove: When jealousy points at something you could actually build, it stops being a verdict and becomes a map to the work you have been avoiding.

exampleSpecs.domain: Source case: Molly and the neighborhood designer
exampleSpecs.audience: Esti and readers facing comparison as teacher
exampleSpecs.stakes: The person who triggers envy often reveals the exact work being avoided.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Esti using comparison as teacher in the source case without controlling another person.
